_comment.about: Since 1.2.0 this half holds Supacharge's landing page sections and the page that serves `/` (Ray, 2026-09-03: each home SDK holds its own landing page, like profile in Dart; Ray, 2026-09-07: Supacharge's Flutter home SDK is lms so the same holds for Next.js - core/utils/flutter/composer/supacharge.json flags lms_sdk home_sdk: true). base_sdk >= 1.5.0 carries only the generic landing host (app/landing/page.tsx, components/custom/landing-content.tsx, the page-sections.ts registry, the hero) and this SDK registers its floating nav, sessions, subjects, tutors, features, partners, pricing, faq, testimonials and footer sections into it, one integrations line each at the // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start marker, in page order (the installer anchors each line after the previous one). Their copy is components/custom/landing/lms-landing-config.ts, every claim sourced from the Flutter app's tour guide and strings, the tutor roster, the CAPS lesson pipeline and the product docs; facts no source carries are [[PLACEHOLDER]] tokens listed in LMS_LANDING_PLACEHOLDERS. app/page.tsx is the counterpart of agent_sdk's app/(chat)/page.tsx: anonymous visitors redirect to /landing, signed-in users to the lms home; it reads the session through base_sdk's kernel seam so it works with or without auth_sdk. It lands on the shell's own app/page.tsx (the composer overwrites shell copies, as base_sdk's host files do), so an uncomposed shell keeps its own `/`. base_sdk composes first. Since 1.2.0 it also fills the hero itself (Ray, 2026-09-08: the base_sdk hero is a frame whose body the home SDK injects through a registry, like the landing sections; the chat box belongs to agent_sdk): lms-hero-form.tsx registers at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start in base_sdk >= 1.7.0's hero-form.ts (two calls to action, no input) and lms-hero-copy.ts at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start in base_sdk >= 1.6.0's hero-copy.ts (Supacharge's words over HERO_CONFIG; draft copy pending Ray's approval). Since 1.2.0 the tutors and pricing sections render the app's cards (Ray, 2026-09-08: bring the tutor and subscription cards to nextjs so their images show and they flip): lms-tutor-card.tsx and lms-plan-card.tsx over the lms-flip-card.tsx primitive (rotateY flip on click / Enter / Space, hover on fine pointers, crossfade under prefers-reduced-motion), the portraits from templates/public/team (installed at public/team, served at /team/...) through the generated team-assets.ts manifest - both written by lms/dart/tool/sync_team_assets.dart, the same tool and CI workflow that vendors lms/team into the Dart half's assets/team (Ray: if in dart assets are in lms, they should also be in lms in nextjs). Since 1.2.0 the landing also carries Supacharge's own look (Ray, 2026-09-08: give it its own feel like the Dart Supacharge app): components/custom/landing/lms-theme.css holds the Dart AppStyle tokens (primary #FF6600, surface #101010, card #1C1C1C, stroke #2E2E2E, ink #FFFFFF / #8C8C8C; the light set behind html.sc-landing:not(.dark), the same class Tailwind’s dark: variants read, so the host’s theme toggle drives both at once) and the shared card/chip/badge/button shapes; lms-fonts.ts loads Inter and Montserrat through next/font/google (the same Google families the Dart app fetches through google_fonts; no bundled font files); lms-theme.tsx puts the tokens and the font variables on <html> while the landing is mounted, defaults the mode to `dark` only when the host has not set one (1.5.2), and is registered first through lms-theme-section.tsx (order -2); lms-wordmark.tsx is the Dart wordmark (Montserrat Black Italic + the registered mark) traced to one SVG path, also installed as public/brand/supacharge-wordmark(.svg|-ink.svg). Every lms section, the hero body and the floating nav read those tokens; base_sdk's hero frame, which hard-codes its colours and a fixed 250px wordmark slot, is re-painted from lms-theme.css through its #hero id until the frame grows a hook (see CHANGELOG 1.2.0). Since 1.5.1 Pricing is a floating-nav stop again (Ray, 2026-09-08: "pricing not injected so floating nav doesnt have it"). It had none because the section hides itself when the platform returns no plan rows and a static meta.nav would have left a tick scrolling nowhere; base_sdk >= 1.11.0 takes a meta.renders predicate over the page facts, so lms-pricing.tsx now carries a real {id: "pricing", label: "Pricing"} entry plus renders: ({plans}) => showsPricing(plans) - the one predicate its own render guard uses - and the host drops the section and the stop together when there is nothing to price. Since 1.7.0 it also answers the header half of Ray's "menus in header and footer are not injected". The footer half was never missing - lms-footer-section.tsx has rendered LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.footer.links (Sessions, Subjects, Tutors, Partners, FAQ plus the auth links and the app link) since this SDK shipped its footer - but supacharge.app's HEADER carried only the wordmark, the theme toggle and the two auth links, because components/custom/header.tsx is the host shell's own file (base_sdk `requires`) and no SDK may ship it. base_sdk 1.13.0 added the seam: components/custom/landing/lms-header-menu.ts is registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start and names SECTION IDS - sessions, subjects, tutors, features, partners, pricing, faq - not hrefs and not labels, so the word on screen and the Partners NEW badge come from each section's own meta.nav and there is no second list to fall out of step. base_sdk resolves them against the page's live nav, so `pricing` disappears from the header on a render where lms-pricing.tsx's `renders` predicate turns the section down rather than linking to an absent anchor. `testimonials` is deliberately not in the menu while that section still shows [[TESTIMONIAL_n_QUOTE]] placeholder copy, and no fixed `links` are declared: sign-in and sign-up already sit in the host header beside the row, and the app download (LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.app) points off-site to a releases page the footer already carries. Since 1.8.0 most of the landing's card sections are ONE swipeable row below 640px rather than a column of cards (Ray, 2026-09-09: "actually most cards should be one row in mobile. even subjects cards", because "im avoiding a long scroll"): components/custom/landing/lms-theme.css carries one .sc-row class - the same snap row .sc-deck already is, as a class rather than the lms-card-deck.tsx component, so a section keeps its own markup, its own card components and a tap that still flips a plan card - and the features, subjects, pricing, session-steps, testimonials and partners grids each add it. The rules sit in a single @media (max-width: 639.98px) block and every converted section is pixel-identical from 640px up, measured at six viewports; the grids drop the grid-cols-1 they no longer need and the md:-breakpoint ones pin sm:grid-cols-1 in its place to hold the 640-767px band. Left stacked: the session FACTS (paragraphs, not cards), the FAQ accordion and the footer link list. Also in 1.8.0 the testimonials row carries FIVE items instead of three (Ray, 2026-09-09: "i need you to add 2 more so when i replace i will replace all. right now is about the design") - all five are PLACEHOLDER stand-ins, first names and roles only, and LMS_LANDING_PLACEHOLDERS names all five and asks for all five to be replaced. The tutors section was already the deck. No base_sdk change and no new file: base_sdk holds only the landing HOST, so a card section's layout is this SDK's own, and rokct.ai's sections are agent_sdk's separate copies - this does not reach them. Since 1.9.0 the copy covers IEB as well as CAPS (Ray, 2026-09-09: "its joining it. though i havent added tutors and assistants of IEB but since ieb extends caps i can use same team"). IEB schools sit the NSC on the same DBE CAPS curriculum - factory/lessons/curriculum/IEB/README.md: "the IEB teaches the same CAPS content", what differs is assessment (the per-subject SAGs) - so the subjects eyebrow reads "Built for CAPS and IEB", the subjects blurb and the What-is-Supacharge answer name the shared curriculum, the Subjects feature card drops the curriculum word it did not need, and one new FAQ item, "Does this work for IEB?", says so plainly and ends by stating that IEB past papers are not included. The claim is deliberately held to SHARED CURRICULUM CONTENT and nothing else: there is no IEB assessment layer in the product - the published lesson indexes carry zero IEB rows, the index builders are pointed at the CAPS root and lms_course has no curriculum field - and the company does not hold permission to reproduce IEB past papers (Ray, 2026-09-09: "we cant do practice as we dont have permission for past papers for IEB"; factory/lessons/curriculum/IEB/SOURCES.md carries the commercial-use flag behind that). So nothing here says IEB-aligned, offers IEB past papers, or implies an IEB-specific lesson set, and no IEB mark or weighting figure appears. The closing clause states an absence, not a plan: it says the papers are not included rather than "not yet", because a promise of assessment material the company has no permission to reproduce would be its own untruth. The team is unchanged on Ray's own say-so: the CAPS tutors, assistants and schedule serve both, and lms/team/**/CAPS/ stays as it is - those paths are identifiers read by sync_team_assets.dart, build_tutor_catalog.py and the live /team/... image URLs, not copy. The Dart half carries the same two strings in templates/tour/lms.tour.yaml (manifest 1.16.8), reworded identically so the guided tour and the site do not diverge. Since 1.10.0 the testimonials are rokct.ai's auto-scrolling row (Ray, 2026-09-09: Supacharge is to inherit rokct.ai's auto-scrolling testimonials): lms-testimonials-section.tsx keeps its frame and heading and renders base_sdk >= 1.14.0's components/custom/landing/testimonials-marquee.tsx over LMS_LANDING_CONFIG.testimonials, with the card re-themed through the marquee's cardClassName prop (sc-card, the same p-6, the 350px width the track needs) and the edge fades through fadeClassName (from-[var(--sc-card-alt)], the section's ground); the words inside the card, which the marquee paints zinc with no prop to change, are re-painted with the card's ink from lms-theme.css through the sc-marquee/sc-marquee-card classes the section adds, the way the hero frame is. A [[TOKEN]] quote is still shown bare, never wrapped in quotation marks. The .sc-row swipe row is gone from this one section because the marquee is one horizontal row at every width. Also in 1.10.0 the new/soon pill lms-floating-nav.tsx draws is base's ONE components/custom/menu-label.tsx (bg-primary, black text) instead of its own --sc-primary span, so the nav and the header - base's since 1.14.0, with this SDK's lms-header-menu.ts rendered inside it - can never show two different labels; and components/custom/landing/lms-site-metadata.ts registers Supacharge's <title>, description, tagline, keywords, locale and wordmark at base_sdk 1.15.0's // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start marker (components/custom/landing/site-metadata.ts) with one integrations line. That last file is optional in the base floor: against 1.14.0 the installer prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line, which is why lms-site-metadata.ts declares the shape it fills itself instead of importing base's SiteMetadataCopy (an import of a file that is not on disk would fail the build). The base_sdk floor is 1.14.0 since 1.10.0: the header that renders the menu, menu-label.tsx and the marquee ship together there.
